scope: Source-specific reference only: profiles50/55/60,50ARbase,fourboughtoffers. This is not evidence for other profiles or complete50–95step1coverage.
method: Every round directly executes byte-for-byte captured actual Site public engine sources, then the separate frozen bought-bonus floor adapter. All 50/55/60 endpoint reference profiles are held out at50ARbase with independent seeds. No fast surrogate or tuning is used.

definitions.return: Whole-round gross payout divided by the entire charged bonus purchase price, including all played spins and engine minimum payments.
definitions.floor: Separate adapter payment equal to max(0,ceil(10% of full charge)-actual engine payout).
definitions.profit: Final gross payout strictly above the full purchase charge.
definitions.mean95CI: Approximate normal 95% Monte Carlo mean confidence interval using unbiased sample variance; not an exact theoretical RTP or guarantee.
definitions.spinReconciliation: Awarded = played + unplayed, plus all visible frame/win cents. Existing cap stops in the sealed LeXof engine are recorded rather than changed.
definitions.raw: The unmodified engine result already includes its existing 5% bonus payment for MaskHouse/LeXof.
definitions.independence: Fresh 128-bit random seeds are saved before any round executes, one per row; parameters/adapter are frozen before validation.

randomAlgorithm: xoshiro128** uint32 rejection sampling; deterministic research RNG only.

sourceCaptureReceipt.source: Actual Site source files copied byte for byte before endpoint holdout; these are not surrogate engines.
